title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing SQL statement permission check in form import and field creation in Visforms…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla Extension vi-solutions Visforms versions 1.0.0-5.6.4 and 6.0.0-6.2.1 allows backend users without the core.create.sql.statement permission to import forms or create new fields that store arbitrary SQL statements. This occurs because the permission check for executing SQL statements was missing during these operations.
